description: Probes whether the H_4 linking weight formula generalizes to H_7 for the deuteron. Result: NO — H_7 Wedderburn sums (~40) are 7x larger than the deuteron scale factor (5.85). The H_4 formula has a special structure (h-series terminates at h^2) not shared by H_7. The Geom linking weight does NOT generalize by computing the same Wedderburn sum at H_{3A+1}.

data.conclusion: H_7 sum is 7x too large. The H_4 formula is specific to n=4.
